paragraphs: The F-Pace SVR is the performance flagship of the F-Pace range, powered by the AJ133 5.0-litre supercharged V8 — badged as P550. It's the same engine family used across Jaguar and Land Rover's high-performance models, including the Range Rover Sport SVR and Velar SVAutobiography, delivering 550PS in this application. The AJ133 is a well-established supercharged V8 design, and while it's a powerful and characterful engine, it has known wear points on timing chain components and the cooling system that we address as standard during every rebuild. The F-Pace SVR has been in production since 2018 on the X761 platform, and remains current — we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar F-Pace SVR Engine Codes AJ133 A 5.0-litre supercharged V8 fitted to the F-Pace SVR from 2018 to present, on the X761 platform. Known for timing chain wear and cooling system leaks — an established pattern across Jaguar and Land Rover models using this same engine family. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every AJ133 rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace SVR from 2023 to present. The AJ133 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
